scope: small browser and Flash games only; exclude console-emulator and Unity titles
runtime: Ruffle from the pinned Seraph source tree when Flash games are included
notes: Assets are downloaded during the static build and served as separate same-origin files; they are not embedded in index.html.
The per-game size cutoff is the user's confirmed lightweight scope. It is not a Vercel deployment-size guarantee.
Device support is an estimate inferred from launcher markup and input signals. No gameplay or real-device test is implied.
